title: Warp Hole arena module — paired cells teleport bombers + bombs between each other
intent: Second hazard module from `gameplay-systems.md §11` catalogue, after Conveyor Belt (GDP-2026-05-26-003). A warp hole is a pair of grid cells linked bidirectionally; any bomber or bomb stepping on cell A is instantly teleported to cell B (and vice versa), with a 0.3s cooldown per warp pair to prevent infinite-loop trapping. Pairs can be authored in the scene file (`warps: [{a: {gx, gz}, b: {gx, gz}}]`). Unlike Conveyor, warps are INSTANTANEOUS — no per-tick push — and don't affect facing direction. They add cross-arena movement that bypasses walls, giving smaller arenas a 'larger feel' without enlarging the grid.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gameplay-systems.md §11` (Warp Hole: Wait — 'best for MVP-3 chunked map'; revising verdict because the current per-arena scene-author pattern from S143 makes warp authoring trivial). Continues the content-variety thread (user direction 2026-05-26 + 2026-05-27). Two hazards (Conveyor + Warp Hole) give the arena variety a substantially different feel from the 6 topology-only variants — same physical layout reads completely different with one warp pair shifting movement options.
acceptanceHints: Depends on GDP-2026-05-26-003 (Conveyor Belt) being shipped is NOT required — warp is independent. Sequenced after Conveyor in design intent because Conveyor sets the hazard-module pattern (component + system + visual treatment + scene authoring); warp follows the same shape.
examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
WarpHole component { pairId: integer, role: 'a' | 'b' } — placed on the cell entity
Pair authoring: scenes declare `warps: [{ a: {gx, gz}, b: {gx, gz}, pairId: N }]` — the scene-load step spawns the two WarpHole-tagged cell entities.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/warp-hole-system.ts: NEW.
Query: entities with GridPosition + (PlayerControlled or BotBrain or Bomb) ON a cell that ALSO has a WarpHole entity.
Per fixedUpdate: for each such entity, find the partner WarpHole (same pairId, opposite role). Snap GridPosition + Transform.position to the partner cell.

Per-pair cooldown: each WarpHole pair tracks `lastWarpAt: number`. If now - lastWarpAt < 300ms, the warp is SUPPRESSED. Prevents infinite ping-pong if a bomber lands on the destination cell with movement queued.
Bomb teleportation: bombs with fuseRemaining > 0 warp normally. Bombs that just detonated (fuseRemaining = 0, BlastEvent pending) DO NOT warp — the BlastEvent fires at the original cell.
Owner bomb on warp cell when placed: bomb spawns at the placer's current cell (warp cell A), then NEXT fixedUpdate it gets warped to cell B (one-tick delay). Fuse continues normally.
VISUAL TREATMENT:

Warp cells use a new `warp-vortex` shader OR a simpler implementation: a spinning ring of pickup-glow-cyan particles. Both cells of a pair share visual style + a hue derived from pairId (deterministic — pair 0 = cyan, pair 1 = magenta, etc.).
Optional: paired cells emit a faint thin line connecting them when both are visible on minimap (helps players read the pairing).
Pair-cooldown state visualisation: when on cooldown, the cyan ring dims to 30% opacity for 0.3s.
AUDIO:
New event `warp-tick` — quick whoosh + reverb tail at warp moment. Fires once per warp event (whichever entity warped).
Voice synth: a place-bomb voice slot's first syllable could fire on warp as a 'wow' — optional polish; leave for follow-up if dev wants.
GAMEPLAY IMPLICATIONS:

Bomber places bomb → bomber walks INTO warp → bomber teleports → bomb still ticks on original cell → bomb detonates → blast reaches the warp cell, kills nobody there (bomber escaped via warp). Telegraphs warp as defensive option.
Bomber kicks bomb INTO warp → bomb teleports to partner cell → bomb continues to fuse on partner cell.
Bomber chases via warp → enters cell A, teleports to B; the chase becomes a positional puzzle.

Warp pair on a cell that's also a Conveyor (rare authoring): conveyor pushes the bomber, lands ON the warp cell, warps. Order: warp system runs AFTER conveyor system (define schedule order in bootstrap).
Blast on warp cell: BlastTile spawns normally; nothing transmits through the warp. Blast does NOT teleport. This is intentional — warps are movement-only, not damage-vectors.

MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative, post-GDP-022-011): server runs warp-hole-system. Warps are deterministic; the cooldown timer is server wall-clock per pair. Snapshot reflects the post-warp GridPosition; client interpolates remote bomber to the new position (the existing remote-bomber-interpolator handles teleport-jumps — when delta > 1 cell, it snaps instead of smoothing).
BOT AI:
Bot path-finding sees warp pairs as 0-cost teleport edges. A bot pathfinding from cell C to cell D will use a warp if it's strictly shorter.
Stretch: bot AVOIDS landing on a warp cell if the partner cell is currently in a blast path (don't teleport into death). Optional polish.
Stretch: bot uses warp DEFENSIVELY when its current cell is in a bomb's projected blast and a warp cell is reachable in fewer steps than safe-evade-perpendicular.
AUTHORING — initial cut:
scenes/start.scene.json: NO warps (default arena stays warp-free).
scenes/wide.scene.json: NO warps (preserves current behaviour).
scenes/corridor.scene.json: optional ONE pair connecting the two ends (interesting — long corridor becomes a loop). Decide based on playtest.
scenes/plaza.scene.json: NO warps (open arena needs no extra movement).
scenes/cross.scene.json: optional 4 pairs connecting opposite-quadrant corners (cross becomes a network).
scenes/pit.scene.json: ONE pair inside the ring (puzzle-shaped pit play).
New scene? `warpfield.scene.json` — a 15×11 with 3-4 warp pairs scattered. Showcases the module.
UNIT TESTS:
Bomber on warp cell A → next fixedUpdate, bomber at cell B.
Bomb on warp cell A → next fixedUpdate, bomb at cell B; fuseRemaining unchanged.
Cooldown: bomber walks A → B → tries to walk back to B (which warps back to A) within 300ms → second warp suppressed.
Cooldown release: 350ms later → next warp works.
Two bombers on same warp cell A simultaneously → both teleport to B; bomber-on-bomber collision resolution from gameplay-systems.md §2.4 takes over at B.
Bomb mid-detonation (fuseRemaining = 0): NOT teleported.
Pairing integrity: pairId/role tags match exactly one A + exactly one B; mismatched scenes reject at engine:check.
DETERMINISM: warp decisions are deterministic per cell entry; cooldown uses fixedUpdate dt. Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to resolve within budget.
OUT OF SCOPE:
More than 2 cells per pair (triplet warps).
Directional warps (one-way warps from A to B, no return).
Warps that affect blast / damage propagation.
Warps with cooldown shared globally across all pairs in an arena.
Player-placed warps (level-editor adjacent — defer indefinitely).
Warp animation tween — instantaneous in v1; if tween-fade is nicer in playtest, follow-up story.
